item.content:encoded: Real world vector search workloads are increasingly large and complex. Enterprises are not using vector search to occasionally search through a couple of PDF files. They are indexing and searching billions of vectors at thousands of requests per second (RPS) and sub 50ms tail latency. Large enterprises also can’t tolerate faulty assumptions.Too many benchmarks use gated, proprietary managed services.
